Indian Standard 
RATED PRESSURES OF AIR COMPRESSORS 

( First Revision ) 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Lays down, a series of preferred pressures to be used when presenting data for 
compressors. 

1.1 Components for compressed air system shall be designed to meet the standardized pressure. 

2. Definition — For the purpose of this standard, the following definition shall apply. 

2.1 Rated Pressure — A pressure in the range specified in this standard to meet the user's and the 
manufacturer's needs for establishing pressure levels between 0-4 and 400 bars. 

Note — It can be presumed that a compressor has its optional or near optional performance at its rated pressure. 

3. Rated Pressures — The preferred rated pressures ( gauges ) shall be as given in Table 1.

IS : 9242 - 1986 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was earlier published in 1979 on the basis of ISO/DIS 5941 and is being revised to 
be in line with ISO 5941-1979 'Compressors, pneumatic tools and machine — Preferred pressures'. 

In compressors industry, standardized rated pressures for some fields of application, deviation 
from the ideal series shall be accepted. The two deviations are: 

7 bars (~ 100 lbf/in 2 gauge) 
18 bars (~ 250 lbf/in 2 gauge) 

In addition, only pressure, 12*5 bar, has been taken from the preferred values. The standardized 
rated pressure range for the compressor field thus contain only half of many values as the range for the 
fluid power field, which shall be considered an advantage. 

If the manufacturer has to choose design pressure outside the standard range for a new 
application, the range of pressure for compressors may be used for guidance.
